name: api-governance-openai
description: CodeRifts API governance for Codex/OpenAI — preflight contract change sets, verify signed receipts, and look up past decisions before merge or ship.

interface.shortDescription: Preflight API/tool-contract changes before merge or ship
interface.longDescription: CodeRifts API governance for agents: call preflight_change_set before merge, deploy, publish, or tool registration when a contract artifact changed; branch on execution_action only; use verify_receipt for a receipt you already hold and get_decision_details for a past decision. Hosted Streamable HTTP MCP at https://app.coderifts.com/mcp exposes exactly those three tools.
defaultPrompt: Preflight this OpenAPI change before merge
Verify the CodeRifts receipt I already hold
Look up a past CodeRifts decision by id
